description: Fetch a brand page from INKEEDecoder (formerly INCIDecoder) and its catalogue of products, one page at a time. Accepts a slug, a /brands/ path, or an inkeedecoder.com or incidecoder.com URL. Read-only.

id.description: Brand slug, site path (/brands/...), or brand URL on inkeedecoder.com or incidecoder.com. The slug is the last segment of the page URL.

page.description: 1-based page number. Each response states whether another page is available.

name: inkeedecoder_get_brand

products.description: This page of the brand's products.

name.description: Display name as shown on the site.

slug.description: Stable key; pass it back as the `id` of a lookup tool.

nextPageUrl.description: URL of the next page, present when hasMore is true.

title: Get a brand's products
